claim: P94 GATE: the P93 P0 is closed. Over the same 846-file corpus the compliance stage — which found 29 workbooks shipping two shared string tables at P93 — now finds zero introduced defects, and active roundtrip recovers to 840/841. The one remaining active failure is the known placeholder-sheet boundary, reported as a typed error.

fix.effect: SharedStrings.flush() and the part lookup fall back to a case-insensitive match, so a package already carrying xl/sharedstrings.xml is not treated as having no shared string table. Kept as defense-in-depth.

Root cause. _Relationships.load_from_xml resolved internal targets by literal part name; a rel Target="/xl/sharedStrings.xml" against entry xl/sharedstrings.xml was reported dangling, hiding the part from the object model. Now falls back to a case-insensitive lookup when exactly one candidate matches; ambiguous packages still warn.

closed_since_p93.verification: spreadJS/1111.xlsx — open, write a string cell, save: archive holds exactly one shared string part, count 38 -> 39 with the marker appended rather than a fresh 1-entry table.

fix.effect: Chartsheet implements the save-time flush protocol; RED test test_save_after_accessing_chartsheet_does_not_crash.

open_items.symptom: 'ARIMA Module' has no worksheet part (empty r:id); it is a placeholder sheet and cannot be opened. Typed error, not a bare KeyError. sample29.xlsx.
open_items.note: Decide whether a placeholder sheet should be skipped on save rather than raising.

open_items.symptom: BadZipFile — legacy OLE2 .xls content with an .xlsx extension. Documented substrate boundary.
